analysis_md:
方程变形为 $\frac{dx}{dy}+(\cot y)x=\cos y$

通解为 $x=e^{-\int\cot y\,dy}\left(\int\cos y\cdot e^{\int\cot y\,dy}\,dy+C\right)=\frac{1}{\sin y}\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^2 y+C\right)$，代入 $y(1)=\frac{\pi}{6}$，得 $C=\frac{3}{8}$
search_text:
$(x-\sin y)dy+\tan y\,dx=0$ 在初始条件 $y(1)=\frac\pi6$ 下的特解为（ ） $\frac1{\sin y}(\frac12\sin^2y+\frac38)$ $\frac1{\cos y}(\frac12\sin^2y+\frac38)$ $\frac1{\sin y}(\frac12\cos^2y+\frac38)$ $\frac1{\cos y}(\frac12\cos^2y+\frac38)$ 方程变形为 $\frac{dx}{dy}+(\cot y)x=\cos y$

通解为 $x=e^{-\int\cot y\,dy}\left(\int\cos y\cdot e^{\int\cot y\,dy}\,dy+C\right)=\frac{1}{\sin y}\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^2 y+C\right)$，代入 $y(1)=\frac{\pi}{6}$，得 $C=\frac{3}{8}$
